edits.old: The only rows this story writes are the inbox, the run lock and stored keys, the run's own outbox rows through the library, and the run decision record.
edits.new:
The only rows this story writes are the inbox, the run lock and stored keys, the run's own outbox rows through the library, and the run decision record.

**Personal data.** Personal-data fields carried by this story are `person_key` (DF-ACE-056) and `account_key` (DF-ACE-001), and the groups of the run summary, which carry `person_key` by person and product group. The alert and the run record carry counts, business dates, data product codes and message ids only (section 14). `decision_record` is a library table of the platform library (section 12.7), not an entity of the Logical Data Model v9 or Data Classification v5; it carries the counts, the outcome and the freshness answers of the run (DF-DEC-001 to DF-DEC-018).
